detail.title: Explicit Falsification in AI-Generated Science
detail.summary: An examination of whether autonomous multi-agent systems can employ explicit falsification agents to test and challenge research assumptions.
detail.reason: Synthesizes collected evidence regarding Baby-AIGS and falsification-driven autonomous agent architectures.
